dossier_meta.catalog_title: Converse to Theorem 1.1 (3-Coloring dichotomy for $H$-free graphs)
dossier_meta.statement_text: If every component of $H$ is a path, then the $3$-Coloring Problem restricted to $H$-free graphs can be solved in polynomial time.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 1.1 (Holyer; Kamiński and Lozin) establishes that if $H$ has at least one component which is not a path then the $3$-Coloring Problem on $H$-free graphs is NP-hard. Immediately after stating this theorem the paper notes: 'The converse to Theorem 1.1 is wide open.'
